verses.text: She saw that he was a fine child.
verses.title: God’s Portrait of You

verses.text: speaking to one another with psalms, hymns, and songs from the Spirit. Sing and make music from your heart to the Lord, always giving thanks to God the Father for everything, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves
